properties.notes: Supermarket premises in Prudhoe town centre comprising retail floorspace at ground-floor level and underused storage space above. Could offer scope for residential use through conversion of the upper floors to flats. An application has now been approved for alteration and conversion of the first-floor to provide 6 apartments (18/04526/FUL).The existing shop unit will remain in situ and will not be impacted by the proposal. Development yet to commence but forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
